microsoft365.name: Microsoft 365 public status
microsoft365.client_impact: May confirm a broad public Microsoft 365 incident, but does not certify tenant or workload health for Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune, Apps, Defender, Power Platform, or other subscribed services.
microsoft365.technician_action: Use only the incident scope Microsoft publishes. Check tenant Microsoft 365 Service Health or Graph service communications before concluding that an individual workload is healthy or affected.

kaseya.client_impact: May affect Autotask PSA, Datto, Kaseya RMM, backup, or MSP operations.
kaseya.technician_action: Confirm the affected US product and region on the Kaseya status page before changing local systems.

datto.name: NUSO
datto.client_impact: May affect UCaaS, inbound/outbound calling, Teams or Zoom bridges, Operator Connect, SMS/MMS, emergency calling, CPaaS, portals, or APIs.
datto.technician_action: Check NUSO incident/component scope and upstream carrier status before changing PBX, SIP, routing, or client voice configuration.
